# Personnel Safety System

The credited chain guarantees that nobody is inside an enclosure while there is
any possibility of radiation in it. It is built from redundant, diverse hardware
logic; no software decision is in the credited path, and no operator action can
bypass it from a console.

Access is granted only after a search: two trained searchers sweep the enclosure
along a fixed route, pressing search boxes in order and within a time window, and
the last door closed arms the chain. A door opened afterwards, a search box
pressed out of sequence, or a timer expiring all revoke the permit immediately.

Revoking the permit inhibits every source at once — the electron gun, the booster,
and the injection kickers — and simultaneously closes the photon shutters, so any
beam already circulating is dumped and no radiation reaches an occupied hutch.

The chain is exercised in full at every long shutdown, and the certificate from
that test is what allows operation to resume.
